title: Preheat oven to 425F
description: Move rack to middle. Put sheet pan in oven to preheat.

title: Cut vegetables
description: Cut into 1-inch chunks. Toss with oil and salt.

title: Roast vegetables
description: Spread on hot pan, then stir at 15 minutes.

title: Sear steaks
description: Pat dry. Heat pan until just smoking. Cook 2-3 minutes per side, then rest 5 minutes.

title: Make pan sauce
description: Deglaze with stock or wine, reduce, and finish with butter.

title: Dress greens
description: Toss greens with vinaigrette just before serving.
